title: Vibe Engineering v2
summary: Human-directed V.I.B.E. method: reality before invention, Intent-Standard-Evidence, controlled divergence, no-slop quality, independent challenge, proof, ownership, and earned retention.
laws: Diverge before deciding only when divergence helps.
Small finished moves beat wide unfinished motion.
Retention is earned, not manufactured through lock-in.
ownershipRule: The owner can understand, export, move, replace providers or builders, recover, and continue operating.
productionRule: Deployment is not production proof; target-environment evidence is required.
